summary: Tested all latest revision features (backend + frontend) after the refactor. Backend: 87/87 pytest pass (62 existing regression + 25 new tests I added for contract/invoice DOCX, NIK gate, schedule H+3/H+1 rules, full verified->delivered->installation E2E, and auth playbook checks). Frontend: /sewa free step navigation + datalist autocomplete + final red validation verified; /tracking polling, invoice DOCX download links, installation jam-only auto date verified; 12 admin pages load clean with polling wired; admin NIK gate button state verified. One real UX defect found on /tracking (recurring error toast every poll for orders with past installation_date) and one environment issue (stale CRA dev bundle until frontend restart).

minor.issue: No pagination/search params (returns up to 1000 docs) and does an N+1 customer lookup per order; every admin page now polls these full lists every 15-20s -> scaling risk

When body.nik is empty the gate silently falls back to the stored customer.nik, so a returning customer can be approved without the admin entering/confirming NIK. Confirm this is intended (frontend still requires 16 digits in the input, so it only affects direct API use).

ui_bugs.issue: Error toast 'Tanggal tidak boleh di masa lalu' appears on unlock AND again on every 20s poll for orders whose installation_date is already in the past (reproduced with CLM-20260817-8U8U / 082112223333, installation_date 2026-08-21). Root cause: unlock() and refresh() call loadSlots(data.installation_date) unconditionally; GET /api/public/slots returns 400 for past dates and loadSlots toasts the error. Fix: only fetch slots when order status === 'delivered' AND installation_date >= today, and never toast during silent polling refresh.

Shows 'Kontrak PDF bertanda tangan telah diterima dan dapat dilihat admin...' even when the contract was signed through the legacy e-sign endpoint with no PDF uploaded (verified on CLM-20260822-0JB3). Misleading copy.

integration_issues.issue: Before I restarted the frontend, the served CRA bundle was one edit behind (invoice 'Unduh Invoice' anchor + data-testid=invoice-download-* were missing from the DOM while present in source and in /static/js/bundle.js). After `supervisorctl restart frontend` all 6 invoice download links rendered and returned 200 DOCX. Main agent should verify compile/restart after edits before self-testing.

critical_code_review_comments: routes_public.full_access_payload always returns installation_date derived from delivered_at even for installed/active/completed orders; the frontend then queries /public/slots with a past date. Either return null once installation is done or let the frontend gate the call.
routes_admin.py is 718 lines and mixes units/tariffs/orders/invoices/settings/users; consider splitting per resource before it grows further.

contract_service.generate_invoice_docx wraps its whole table-mutation block in `except Exception: pass`, so a template change would silently produce a partly-empty invoice. Log the exception at minimum.
usePolling has no document.visibilityState guard and no jitter; with 18 pages at 15-20s intervals this multiplies load once several tabs are open.

rca_of_the_issue: Tracking error toast: full_access_payload computes installation_date = delivered_at + 1 day for every order that has a delivery record, including installed/active ones. Tracking.jsx unlock()/refresh() call loadSlots(installation_date) whenever that field is truthy; GET /api/public/slots rejects dates before today with HTTP 400 ('Tanggal tidak boleh di masa lalu'), and loadSlots surfaces the failure via toast.error, so the customer sees a red error on unlock and again on each 20s poll. Reproduce: /tracking -> CLM-20260817-8U8U -> kontak 082112223333 -> unlock. Mitigation: gate slot loading on order status 'delivered' plus a future installation_date, and keep polling refresh silent.
